subject: Simple question about intercepts in a standardized solution

messages.author: 1e94001192669559
messages.subject: Simple question about intercepts in a standardized solution
parts: I'm rather puzzled. 2-group, 2-factor oblique cfa. I notice in a lavaan printout that the estimated unstandardized intercept in a two-group solution is Estimate=3.193. However, I notice that the standardized solution also has an intercept std.LV= 3.193 and the std.all=3.156. I can somewhat understand that maybe we might report out the intercept for the standardized solution but am puzzled as to why the std.all solution gives a different intercept. TIA.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Simple question about intercepts in a standardized solution
parts:
It is in units of SD, if you find that meaningful to report.  "std.all" standardized both latent and observed variables.  Because your "std.lv" solution is the same as the unstandardized one, I'm guessing your model already had standardized latent variables (std.lv = TRUE or explicitly setting factor variances = 1 in your model syntax).
